title: PhysWave: Physics-Guided Latent Diffusion Models for Controllable Spatial Audio Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-spatial audio generation, such as text-to-First-Order Ambisonics (FOA), provides a convenient way to create spatial audio for billion-dollar gaming and film industries. However, existing text-to-FOA methods are largely data-driven and may produce audio that violates acoustic relations between source direction and distance. They also separate descriptive and parametric control, forcing users to trade usability for precision. In this paper, we present PhysWave, a physics-guided latent diffusion model for controllable text-to-FOA generation. PhysWave unifies natural-language and trajectory control through a shared waypoint-caption representation, and augments diffusion training with two differentiable acoustic priors: spherical-harmonic direction consistency and inverse-square distance consistency. translated_title: PhysWave：物理引导的潜在扩散模型用于可控空间音频生成
translated_abstract: 文本到空间音频生成（如文本到一阶Ambisonics，即FOA）为价值数十亿美元的游戏和电影行业提供了一种便捷的空间音频创作方式。然而，现有的文本到FOA方法主要依赖数据驱动，可能生成违反声源方向与距离之间声学关系的音频。这些方法还将描述性控制与参数化控制相分离，迫使用户在易用性与精确度之间做出取舍。本文提出PhysWave，一种用于可控文本到FOA生成的物理引导潜在扩散模型。PhysWave通过共享的航点-描述表示统一了自然语言控制与轨迹控制，并利用两个可微声学先验增强扩散训练：球谐方向一致性与平方反比距离一致性。为支持动态空间生成，我们进一步构建了一个包含30万个片段的FOA数据集，涵盖多样的声音类别和声源轨迹。
tldr: PhysWave是一种物理引导的潜在扩散模型，通过统一的航点-描述表示融合自然语言与轨迹控制，并引入球谐方向一致性和平方反比距离一致性两个可微声学先验，实现了符合物理规律的文本到FOA空间音频可控生成。
en_tdlr: PhysWave is a physics-guided latent diffusion model that unifies natural-language and trajectory control through a shared waypoint-caption representation and incorporates differentiable acoustic priors (spherical-harmonic direction consistency and inverse-square distance consistency) to generate physically consistent, controllable text-to-FOA spatial audio.
